subject: Final OKR heatmap, evidence asks, and tie-break guidance
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace Oconnor <grace@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q2 OKR heatmap: final pass + evidence asks

Team —

Attached is my consolidated heatmap (Q2_OKR_heatmap_v2.xlsx) and a short pack of specific evidence asks (evidence_vignettes.zip). I ran a quick pass against the draft scores and flagged: 1) three objectives with split owner input, 2) two KR measurements that drifted mid-quarter (chart on tab 3), and 3) two items where we lost the signal and need a short vignette that ties activity to outcome.

Please do the following by EOD next Monday (2027-07-05):
- Owners: add a 2–3 sentence evidence vignette for any KR you own that is below a 70% confidence score. Put them into the Drive folder (link below) and drop a note in the Notion page.
- Laura & Vivek: for the split-owner Objectives A and C, propose a tie-break rubric (deadline Fri 07/02) — I sketched 3 heuristics in the score_rationale.docx.
- Grace: can you run an itemized log of where metrics drifted vs. forecast and attach a brief annotated plot? (one-pager)
- Marissa: coordinate comms for the exec QBR slide — I want one slide showing the heatmap + a one-sentence judgement for each Objective.

Quick trade-offs to keep in mind: we should prefer documented impact over activity. If we don't have direct attribution but have reasonable proxy (cohort lift, experiment lift) that's acceptable — just mark it as proxy in the vignette.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cQ2-EOQ-OKR-evidence
Notion: /company/qbr/q2-2027-okr-judgements

Thanks,
Nikhil
Nikhil Sharma
Director, Product
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Q2_OKR_heatmap_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Attachment: evidence_vignettes.zip (archive)

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q2 OKR heatmap: final pass + evidence asks

Nikhil — thanks for pulling this together. Quick notes after a read:

- Objective A (Serving runtime performance): I agree with the 65% confidence call. Metrics show token latency SLO met for 70% of traffic but not on tail. I'll add two vignettes: one from a Canary test (latency histogram) and one customer incident where we had to fallback to a lower-capacity pool.
- Objective C (Platform adoption): Vivek and I proposed different scoring earlier; I think the rubrics should weigh customer success outcomes heavier than raw signups. My tie-break suggestion (sketch): 60% outcome, 30% signal reliability, 10% effort.

I'll drop the vignettes into the Drive by Monday morning and upload a brief slide for the exec QBR.

Laura Bennett
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Agree with Laura's weighting; I iterated on the tie-break rubric and attached a short rationale (score_rationale.docx). For Objective C I'm proposing we incorporate a "signal stability" check: if the primary metric toggled >15% week-over-week during the quarter, down-weight the raw pickup by 1 band.

Two operational asks:
1) Grace — can you surface the raw cohort curves for the platform adoption cohort? I need to see the drop-off point that correlates with the product UX change.
2) Marissa — let's lock the one-slide template so we can slot in the heatmap snapshot and one-sentence judgements.

I'll be on a customer call most of Fri afternoon; ping me in Slack if you need a fast tie-break.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Product Strategy
Redwood Inference

I've pulled the metric drift plots and a short annotated note into Drive (one-pager PDF). Observations: the majority of drift is concentrated in the last 3 weeks of the quarter after a routing change we rolled; the customer incident Laura mentioned aligns to that window. I'm adding the cohort plots Vivek asked for — both are in the folder and linked in the Notion doc.

Also flagged two KR measurements that used different baseline windows; I normalized them and placed the before/after charts in the evidence folder. If anyone wants the raw queries I can paste them here or share a SQL gist.

Team — quick status update and a note for the exec deck.

Status: all evidence vignettes are in the Drive except for one (Objective A, KR 1) — Laura is finishing that and will drop it Monday at 9a. Heatmap updated in the slide template (I exported your colors, Nikhil).

Exec deck ask: Elaine & Chris from StratusHealth asked for a one-line summary of how our platform improvements in Q2 affected their production latency. I drafted a short customer-approved quote and placed it in the "external_quotes.txt" file in the Drive. Elaine — if you could confirm the wording below I will add it to slide 4 for the QBR: 

"With Redwood's routing and cache tweaks this quarter we saw a 12% reduction in 95th percentile latency across our critical pipelines." — StratusHealth

If that looks good, I'll include it and mark it as approved. Otherwise, tell me edits and I'll update.

I'll finalize the single-slide heatmap + judgement set after Laura's last vignette lands. Target to ship the deck to Exec Comms Tue morning.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Program Manager, GTM Ops
Redwood Inference
